description: This file is a shell script that contains test cases for Git repository structure inspection commands. It sets up Git repositories, verifies their structure, and checks command outputs using test assertions.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a successful test case with a description and commands.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after tests.

methods.name: test_commit_bulk
methods.description: Creates multiple commits in a repository.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a single commit with a message.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in the output.

methods.name: test_file_not_empty
methods.description: Checks if a file is not empty.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Verifies the number of lines in a file.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the content of two files.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script execution.
